settings.score: max(freeze, min(acceleration, periodicity), inversion, curvature), in margin units
settings.readiness: all five continuous signals finite; otherwise native until history is available
settings.convergence: all sixteen unfiltered candidates <= -1 for three consecutive executed-query states
settings.search: eight native-noise samples, then eight iid or one smoothed diagonal CEM update; no cross-state optimizer memory
settings.selection: uniform among all sixteen or minimum score; whole native chunk, no action averaging or gate edits
settings.guards: finite native policy actions; no extra gripper-sign or median-radius veto
settings.streams: one original policy draw per executed query; extra noises and choice use separate common random streams
settings.exit: population confirmation or twelve-query budget; then native, with re-alarm recorded but no second intervention

bank_settings.probe: one original-noise query at the original fork, zero executed steps and no RNG/history commit
bank_settings.switch: once at entry: exactly F -> withdraw4; otherwise A -> smooth2; P -> alternating side; I/C -> replan2; none -> resample
bank_settings.random_switch: uniform over the same six possible switch outputs, independent of policy noise
bank_settings.stopping: success or original total 520 steps; physical phases and eight transformed queries are bounded
bank_settings.evaluation: all first alarms including original successes; each repeat separately; old and fresh cohorts reported separately
bank_settings.stability_scope: nominal Cartesian integrator only; MoE scores are observations, not certified Lyapunov or barrier functions
